title: Function schema v0.1
description: A Boolean function as data, shared by every logic tool (truth table, K-map, SOP and POS, the Boolean solver) and the figure editor. The truth table is the truth: `table` has one character per row, "0", "1" or "-" (don't care), and row r gives variables[0] the most significant bit of r. Every expression field must agree with the table on every row that is not a don't care. Expressions use the syntax in logic/expr.mjs: variables are a letter followed by digits, ' or ~ for NOT, juxtaposition or * for AND, ^ or ⊕ for XOR, + for OR. Structure only: agreement with the table, the SOP and POS shapes and the minimal covers are checked by validate/ (both languages).

schema.description: Format and version. Readers reject an unknown major version.

output.description: Name of the output, e.g. F or Y. Default F.

table.description: One character per row: 0, 1 or - (don't care). Its length must be 2 to the number of variables.

expression.description: Optional: the expression the function was written as.

sop.description: Optional: a sum of products for the function, e.g. the canonical sum of minterms.

pos.description: Optional: a product of sums for the function, e.g. the canonical product of maxterms.

sop.description: Every minimal sum of products (fewest terms, then fewest literals). More than one entry means the choice is not unique.

pos.description: Every minimal product of sums, as for sop.

minimal.description: Optional: the minimised forms. When present, a list must hold exactly all the minimal covers.
